exposure: Methodology of insertion (vaginal vs. cesarean delivery)
Timing of vaginal insertion (between 10 minutes and 48 hours)
Cadre of staff performing insertion (doctor vs. nurse)
cohort: The study included 36,766 women who received PPIUDs in 48 hospitals across Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Tanzania, and Kenya.
finding: The study found that PPIUDs have low complication rates and can be safely inserted by a variety of trained health staff.
mod_finding: Expulsion of the PPIUD was less likely after cesarean insertion compared to vaginal insertion.
country: Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Tanzania, Kenya
